$comment: The crises the map can open. A crisis is an editorial grouping of countries that the incident stream, the UCDP register and the news can all be joined on. Which incidents belong to it is decided by country, never by a model. Adding a crisis is a config change.
$wikipediaNote: Titles were resolved against the live Wikipedia API on 2026-10-10 (redirects followed). Background text is the article's own lead, attributed and linked, CC BY-SA 4.0.
$newsQueryNote: Queries run against the GDELT DOC API and Google News. Keep them to place names that are unambiguous; the conflict terms keep sports and travel pieces out.

settings.$autoExcludeNote: UCDP codes some states as parties to wars fought abroad (France and the United States against IS, for example). Their domestic news would otherwise surface as a crisis.
